def transform_to_standardized_schema( self, df: polars.dataframe.frame.DataFrame) -> polars.dataframe.frame.DataFrame: 
590    def transform_to_standardized_schema(
591        self, df: polars.DataFrame
592    ) -> polars.DataFrame:
593        """
594        Transform Conserv API data to standardized schema.
595
596        Parameters
597        ----------
598        df : polars.DataFrame
599            Raw Conserv data with columns: Sensor Name, Time, Temperature (°C), Humidity (%), customer_id, source
600
601        Returns
602        -------
603        polars.DataFrame
604            Data transformed to match standardized schema
605        """
606        if self.logger:
607            self.logger.info("Transforming Conserv data to standardized schema")
608
609        # Create a copy to avoid modifying the original
610        df = df.clone()
611
612        # ============ COLUMN TRANSFORMATIONS ============
613
614        # source - rename existing lowercase column to uppercase
615        if "source" in df.columns:
616            df = df.rename({"source": "Source"})
617        else:
618            df = df.with_columns(polars.lit("Conserv").alias("Source"))
619
620        # SensorReadingF - handle potential encoding issues in column names
621        temp_col = None
622        humidity_col = None
623        
624        for col in df.columns:
625            if "Temperature" in col and ("°C" in col or "Â°C" in col):
626                temp_col = col
627            elif "Humidity" in col and "%" in col:
628                humidity_col = col
629        
630        if temp_col is None:
631            raise ValueError(f"Temperature column not found. Available columns: {df.columns}")
632        if humidity_col is None:
633            raise ValueError(f"Humidity column not found. Available columns: {df.columns}")
634        
635        df = df.with_columns(
636            ((polars.col(temp_col).cast(polars.Float32) * 9 / 5) + 32).alias("SensorReadingF")
637        )
638
639        # SensorReadingRh
640        df = df.rename({humidity_col: "SensorReadingRh"})
641        df = df.with_columns(polars.col("SensorReadingRh").cast(polars.Float32))
642
643        # SensorReadingUTC - handle ISO format like "2025-11-15T18:51:01.729Z"
644        df = df.with_columns(
645            polars.col("Time")
646            .str.replace("Z$", "")  # Remove trailing Z if present
647            .str.strptime(polars.Datetime, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%.f")
648            .dt.timestamp("ms")
649            .floordiv(1000)  # Convert milliseconds to seconds
650            .alias("SensorReadingUTC")
651        )
652
653        # DeviceID
654        df = df.with_columns([
655            polars.concat_str([
656                polars.lit("conserv:"),
657                polars.col("customer_id").cast(polars.String),
658                polars.lit(":"),
659                polars.col("Sensor Serial")
660            ]).alias("DeviceId"),
661            polars.col("Sensor Name").alias("DeviceName"),
662        ])
663
664        # DeviceName
665        df = df.with_columns(
666            df["Sensor Name"].alias("DeviceName")
667        )
668
669        # The data comes in already in device oriented format. We need to transform to sensor oriented format.
670        # Transform each row into two rows: one for Temperature sensor and one for RH sensor
671        
672        # Create Temperature sensor rows
673        temp_rows = df.select([
674            polars.col("Historical"),
675            polars.col("SensorReadingUTC"),
676            polars.col("Source"),
677            polars.col("DeviceId").alias("DeviceID"),
678            polars.col("DeviceName"),
679            polars.concat_str([
680                polars.col("DeviceId"),
681                polars.lit(":Temperature")
682            ]).alias("SensorID"),
683            polars.concat_str([
684                polars.col("DeviceId"),
685                polars.lit(":Temperature")
686            ]).alias("SensorName"),
687            polars.lit("Temperature").alias("SensorType"),
688            polars.col("SensorReadingF"),
689            polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.Float32).alias("SensorReadingRh"),
690            #polars.col("customer_id"),
691            polars.col("QueryUTC")
692        ])
693        
694        # Create RH sensor rows
695        rh_rows = df.select([
696            polars.col("Historical"),
697            polars.col("SensorReadingUTC"),
698            polars.col("Source"),
699            polars.col("DeviceId").alias("DeviceID"),
700            polars.col("DeviceName"),
701            polars.concat_str([
702                polars.col("DeviceId"),
703                polars.lit(":RH")
704            ]).alias("SensorID"),
705            polars.concat_str([
706                polars.col("DeviceId"),
707                polars.lit(":RH")
708            ]).alias("SensorName"),
709            polars.lit("RH").alias("SensorType"),
710            polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.Float32).alias("SensorReadingF"),
711            polars.col("SensorReadingRh"),
712            #polars.col("customer_id"),
713            polars.col("QueryUTC")
714        ])
715        
716        # Combine temperature and RH rows
717        df = polars.concat([temp_rows, rh_rows], how="vertical")
718
719        if self.logger:
720            self.logger.info(f"Conserv transformation complete: {df.shape[0]} records (doubled from device to sensor format)")
721
722        return df

class LicorClient: 
 93class LicorClient:
 94    
 95    def __init__(self, logger: Optional[logging.Logger] = None, home_directory: str = "."):
 96        """
 97        Initialize the LI-COR API client.
 98        
 99        Parameters
100        ----------
101        logger : Optional[logging.Logger]
102            Logger instance for recording API interactions
103        home_directory : str, default="."
104            Base directory for finding .env file
105        """
106        # Read API key from environment
107        api_key = None
108        env_file_path = os.path.join(home_directory, ".env")
109        try:
110            with open(env_file_path) as f:
111                for line in f:
112                    if line.startswith("LICOR_API_KEY"):
113                        api_key = line.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
114                        break
115        except FileNotFoundError:
116            pass
117        
118        if not api_key:
119            raise ValueError(
120                f"LICOR_API_KEY not found in .env file at {env_file_path}. "
121                f"If running from a subdirectory, set home_directory parameter to parent directory (e.g., home_directory='..').")
122        
123        self.api_key = api_key
124        self.logger = logger or logging.getLogger(__name__)
125        self.base_url = "https://api.licor.cloud/v2"
126        self.headers = {
127            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
128            "Content-Type": "application/json"
129        }
130        
131        # Configure logging for detailed API response inspection
132        if self.logger.level == logging.NOTSET:
133            self.logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
134    
135    def _make_api_request(self, endpoint: str, params: Dict[str, Any] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
136        """
137        Make a standardized API request with comprehensive logging.
138        
139        Parameters
140        ----------
141        endpoint : str
142            API endpoint (without base URL)
143        params : Dict[str, Any], optional
144            Query parameters for the request
145            
146        Returns
147        -------
148        Dict[str, Any]
149            Parsed JSON response
150            
151        Raises
152        ------
153        Exception
154            If API request fails
155        """
156        url = f"{self.base_url}/{endpoint.lstrip('/')}"
157        
158        # Log request info
159        self.logger.info(f"Making API request to: {endpoint}")
160        if params:
161            self.logger.debug(f"Parameters: {params}")
162        
163        try:
164            response = requests.get(url, headers=self.headers, params=params)
165            
166            if response.ok:
167                return response.json()
168            else:
169                error_msg = f"API request failed: {response.status_code} - {response.text}"
170                self.logger.error(error_msg)
171                raise Exception(error_msg)
172                
173        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
174            error_msg = f"Request exception: {str(e)}"
175            self.logger.error(error_msg)
176            raise Exception(error_msg)
177    
178    def get_devices(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
179        """
180        Get the list of all devices from the LI-COR API.
181            
182        Returns
183        -------
184        Dict[str, Any]
185            Raw device data from API for inspection
186        """
187        self.logger.info("get_devices")
188        
189        response_data = self._make_api_request("devices", {"includeSensors": "true"})
190        
191        # Log basic device count for tracking
192        if isinstance(response_data, list):
193            self.logger.info(f"Found {len(response_data)} devices")
194        elif isinstance(response_data, dict) and "devices" in response_data:
195            devices = response_data["devices"]
196            self.logger.info(f"Found {len(devices)} devices")
197        
198        return response_data
199    
200    def get_sensor_data(self, device_serial: str, sensor_serial: str, 
201                       start_time_ms: int, end_time_ms: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
202        """
203        Get sensor data for a specific device and sensor.
204        
205        Note: LI-COR API limits historical data queries to maximum 1 year (365 days).
206        If the requested date range exceeds this limit, it will be automatically capped.
207        
208        Parameters
209        ----------
210        device_serial : str
211            Device serial number
212        sensor_serial : str
213            Sensor serial number
214        start_time_ms : int
215            Start time as UTC timestamp in milliseconds
216        end_time_ms : int
217            End time as UTC timestamp in milliseconds
218            
219        Returns
220        -------
221        Dict[str, Any]
222            Raw sensor data from API for inspection
223        """
224        # Validate and cap date range - LI-COR API limits to less than 1 year maximum
225        max_days = 364  # Use 364 days to be safe with API limitations
226        max_milliseconds = max_days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
227        date_range_ms = end_time_ms - start_time_ms
228        
229        if date_range_ms > max_milliseconds:
230            start_time_ms = end_time_ms - max_milliseconds
231            self.logger.warning(
232                f"Date range ({date_range_ms // (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)} days) exceeds LI-COR API limit of {max_days} days. "
233                f"Capping to most recent {max_days} days for {device_serial}/{sensor_serial}."
234            )
235        
236        self.logger.info(f"get_sensor_data for device {device_serial}, sensor {sensor_serial}")
237        
238        params = {
239            "deviceSerialNumber": device_serial,
240            "sensorSerialNumber": sensor_serial,
241            "startTime": start_time_ms,
242            "endTime": end_time_ms
243        }
244        
245        response_data = self._make_api_request("data", params)
246        
247        # Check for pagination - this is an unhandled case that could mean missing data
248        if isinstance(response_data, dict) and response_data.get("moreResults") is True:
249            error_msg = (
250                f"CRITICAL: API returned moreResults=true for {device_serial}/{sensor_serial}. "
251                f"This indicates pagination/truncated results that are not currently handled. "
252                f"Data may be incomplete!"
253            )
254            self.logger.error(error_msg)
255            raise Exception(error_msg)
256        
257        # Log basic data retrieval info
258        if isinstance(response_data, dict):
259            if "message" in response_data:
260                self.logger.info(f"API message: {response_data['message']}")
261            
262            # Log data count for tracking
263            for key in ["data", "readings", "measurements", "values", "results", "sensors"]:
264                if key in response_data and isinstance(response_data[key], list):
265                    self.logger.info(f"Retrieved {len(response_data[key])} items from '{key}'")
266                    break
267        
268        return response_data
269    
270    def transform_to_standardized_schema(self, raw_data: Dict[str, Any], 
271                                       device_serial: str = None,
272                                       device_metadata: polars.DataFrame = None) -> polars.DataFrame:
273        """
274        Transform LI-COR API response data to standardized EnvironmentData schema.
275        
276        Note: This method assumes moreResults=false (complete data). If moreResults=true
277        is ever encountered, get_sensor_data() will raise an exception since pagination
278        is not currently handled.
279        
280        Parameters
281        ----------
282        raw_data : Dict[str, Any]
283            Raw API response from get_sensor_data
284        device_serial : str, optional
285            Device serial number to populate DeviceID field
286        device_metadata : polars.DataFrame, optional
287            Device metadata to attach to readings
288            
289        Returns
290        -------
291        polars.DataFrame
292            Transformed data matching the standardized schema
293        """
294        if not isinstance(raw_data, dict) or "sensors" not in raw_data:
295            self.logger.warning("No sensor data found in response")
296            return polars.DataFrame()
297        
298        # Extract device name from metadata upfront for use in record creation
299        device_name = None
300        if device_metadata is not None and not device_metadata.is_empty():
301            if "deviceName" in device_metadata.columns and len(device_metadata) > 0:
302                device_name = device_metadata.select("deviceName").item(0, 0)
303        
304        all_readings = []
305        
306        for sensor_info in raw_data["sensors"]:
307            sensor_serial = sensor_info.get("sensorSerialNumber", "unknown")
308            
309            for measurement_data in sensor_info.get("data", []):
310                measurement_type = measurement_data.get("measurementType", "unknown")
311                units = measurement_data.get("units", "")
312                records = measurement_data.get("records", [])
313                
314                # Convert records to DataFrame
315                if records:
316                    # Create DataFrame from records (timestamp_ms, value pairs)
317                    df = polars.DataFrame({
318                        "timestamp_ms": [record[0] for record in records],
319                        "value": [record[1] for record in records]
320                    })
321                    
322                    # Add metadata
323                    df = df.with_columns([
324                        # Convert timestamp from ms to seconds
325                        (polars.col("timestamp_ms") / 1000).cast(polars.Int64).alias("SensorReadingUTC"),
326                        polars.lit(f"licor:{device_serial or 'unknown'}-{sensor_serial}").alias("SensorID"),
327                        polars.lit(measurement_type).alias("SensorType"),
328                        polars.lit(units).alias("SensorUnits"),
329                        polars.lit("LI-COR").alias("Source"),
330                        
331                        # Add schema columns - populate DeviceID with device serial when available
332                        polars.lit(f"licor:{device_serial}" if device_serial else None).alias("DeviceID"),
333                        polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.Int32).alias("customer_id"),
334                        # Set SensorName from device metadata: DeviceName_SensorType (e.g., "RX Station 1_RH")
335                        polars.lit(f"{device_name}_{measurement_type}" if device_name else None, dtype=polars.String).alias("SensorName"),
336                        polars.lit(device_name, dtype=polars.String).alias("DeviceName"),
337                        polars.lit(int(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp())).alias("QueryUTC"),
338                        polars.lit(True).alias("Historical"),
339                    ])
340                    
341                    # Map measurement types to standardized reading columns
342                    # Focus on temperature and humidity only
343                    if measurement_type.lower() in ["temperature", "temp"]:
344                        if "°F" in units or "F" in units:
345                            # Already in Fahrenheit - keep this sensor
346                            df = df.with_columns(polars.col("value").cast(polars.Float32).alias("SensorReadingF"))
347                        elif "°C" in units or "C" in units:
348                            # Celsius detected - convert to Fahrenheit
349                            self.logger.info(f"Converting Celsius to Fahrenheit for sensor: {sensor_serial} "
350                                           f"(measurement_type: {measurement_type}, units: {units})")
351                            df = df.with_columns(
352                                (polars.col("value") * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0).cast(polars.Float32).alias("SensorReadingF")
353                            )
354                        else:
355                            # Unknown temperature units - skip and log
356                            self.logger.warning(f"Unknown temperature units for sensor {sensor_serial}: "
357                                              f"measurement_type={measurement_type}, units='{units}' - skipping")
358                            continue
359                    elif measurement_type.lower() in ["rh", "humidity", "relative humidity"]:
360                        df = df.with_columns(polars.col("value").cast(polars.Float32).alias("SensorReadingRh"))
361                    # elif measurement_type.lower() in ["dew point", "dewpoint"]:
362                    #     if "°F" in units or "F" in units:
363                    #         df = df.with_columns(polars.col("value").cast(polars.Float32).alias("SensorReadingDewPointF"))
364                    #     else:
365                    #         df = df.with_columns(polars.col("value").cast(polars.Float64).alias("SensorReadingDewPointC"))
366                    else:
367                        # Skip other sensor types - only collect temperature and humidity
368                        continue
369                    
370                    # Drop the temporary columns
371                    df = df.drop(["timestamp_ms", "value"])
372                    
373                    all_readings.append(df)
374        
375        if not all_readings:
376            return polars.DataFrame()
377        
378        # Concatenate all readings
379        result = polars.concat(all_readings, how="diagonal")
380        
381        # Note: LI-COR API natively returns data in 15-minute intervals,
382        # consistent with Coris (MinReadingSpacing=900) and Conserv (15-min exports)
383        
384        self.logger.info(f"Transformed {len(result)} readings from LI-COR data")
385        return result
386    
387    def get_devices_as_dataframe(self, out_of_scope: List[str] = None,
388                               testing: bool = False,
389                               testing_device_limit: int = 3) -> polars.DataFrame:
390        """
391        Get devices and sensors as a standardized DataFrame.
392        
393        Parameters
394        ----------
395        out_of_scope : List[str], optional
396            List of device name prefixes to exclude
397        testing : bool, default=False
398            If True, limit to first few devices for testing
399        testing_device_limit : int, default=3
400            Number of devices to include when testing mode is enabled
401            
402        Returns
403        -------
404        polars.DataFrame
405            Device and sensor data with standardized schema
406        """
407        out_of_scope = out_of_scope or []
408        current_utc = int(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp())
409        
410        self.logger.info("get_devices_as_dataframe")
411        devices_response = self.get_devices()
412        
413        if not isinstance(devices_response, dict) or "devices" not in devices_response:
414            self.logger.error("Invalid device response format")
415            return polars.DataFrame()
416        
417        devices = devices_response["devices"]
418        
419        # Filter out-of-scope devices
420        if out_of_scope:
421            devices = [d for d in devices 
422                      if not any(d.get("deviceName", "").startswith(prefix) for prefix in out_of_scope)]
423        
424        # Apply testing limits
425        if testing and testing_device_limit:
426            devices = devices[:testing_device_limit]
427        
428        device_records = []
429        
430        for device in devices:
431            device_serial = device.get("deviceSerialNumber")
432            device_name = device.get("deviceName", "Unknown Device")
433            
434            if "sensors" in device:
435                # Create a record for each sensor (temperature and humidity only)
436                for sensor in device["sensors"]:
437                    sensor_serial = sensor.get("sensorSerialNumber")
438                    measurement_type = sensor.get("measurementType", "Unknown")
439                    units = sensor.get("units", "")
440                    latest_value = sensor.get("latest")
441                    
442                    # Filter to only temperature and humidity sensors
443                    if measurement_type.lower() not in ["temperature", "temp", "rh", "humidity", "relative humidity"]:
444                        continue
445                    
446                    device_records.append({
447                        "DeviceID": f"licor:{device_serial}",
448                        "DeviceName": device_name,
449                        "SensorID": f"licor:{device_serial}-{sensor_serial}",
450                        "SensorName": f"{device_name}_{measurement_type}",
451                        "SensorType": measurement_type,
452                        "SensorUnits": units,
453                        "LatestReading": latest_value,
454                        "ProductCode": device.get("productCode"),
455                        "LastConnectionTime": device.get("lastConnectionTime"),
456                        "LoggingState": device.get("loggingState"),
457                        "Alarmed": device.get("alarmed", False),
458                        "UnitSystem": device.get("unitSystem"),
459                    })
460        
461        if not device_records:
462            return polars.DataFrame()
463        
464        # Create DataFrame
465        result = polars.DataFrame(device_records)
466        
467        # Add standardized schema columns
468        result = result.with_columns([
469            polars.lit(current_utc).alias("QueryUTC"),
470            polars.lit("LI-COR").alias("Source"),
471            polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.Int32).alias("customer_id"),
472        ])
473        
474        self.logger.info(f"Retrieved {len(result)} device/sensor combinations")
475        return result
476    
477    def get_historical_data(self, start_utc: int, end_utc: int,
478                               out_of_scope: List[str] = None,
479                               testing: bool = False,
480                               testing_device_limit: int = 2,
481                               testing_sensors_per_device: int = 2) -> List[polars.DataFrame]:
482        """
483        Get historical data for all devices and sensors in bulk.
484        
485        Note: LI-COR API limits historical data queries to maximum 1 year (365 days).
486        If the requested date range exceeds this limit, it will be automatically capped.
487        
488        Parameters
489        ----------
490        start_utc : int
491            Start time as UTC timestamp in seconds
492        end_utc : int
493            End time as UTC timestamp in seconds
494        out_of_scope : List[str], optional
495            List of device name prefixes to exclude
496        testing : bool, default=False
497            If True, limit to first few devices and sensors
498        testing_device_limit : int, default=2
499            Number of devices to include when testing
500        testing_sensors_per_device : int, default=2
501            Number of sensors per device when testing
502            
503        Returns
504        -------
505        List[polars.DataFrame]
506            List of DataFrames containing historical readings
507        """
508        # Validate and cap date range - LI-COR API limits to less than 1 year maximum
509        max_days = 364  # Use 364 days to be safe with API limitations
510        max_seconds = max_days * 24 * 60 * 60
511        date_range_seconds = end_utc - start_utc
512        
513        if date_range_seconds > max_seconds:
514            original_start = start_utc
515            start_utc = end_utc - max_seconds
516            self.logger.warning(
517                f"Date range ({date_range_seconds // 86400} days) exceeds LI-COR API limit of {max_days} days. "
518                f"Capping to most recent {max_days} days."
519            )
520            self.logger.info(f"Adjusted start_utc from {original_start} to {start_utc}")
521        
522        self.logger.info(f"Using date range: {(end_utc - start_utc) // 86400} days of historical data")
523        devices_df = self.get_devices_as_dataframe(
524            out_of_scope=out_of_scope,
525            testing=testing,
526            testing_device_limit=testing_device_limit
527        )
528        
529        if devices_df.is_empty():
530            self.logger.warning("No devices found for bulk historical data retrieval")
531            return []
532        
533        # Convert timestamps to milliseconds for API
534        start_utc_ms = start_utc * 1000
535        end_utc_ms = end_utc * 1000
536        
537        readings_list = []
538        
539        # Get unique device/sensor combinations
540        device_sensor_combinations = (
541            devices_df
542            .filter(polars.col("SensorID").is_not_null())
543            .select(["DeviceID", "SensorID", "DeviceName", "SensorType"])
544            .unique()
545        )
546        
547        if testing:
548            # Group by device and limit sensors per device
549            limited_combinations = []
550            for device_id in device_sensor_combinations["DeviceID"].unique():
551                device_sensors = device_sensor_combinations.filter(
552                    polars.col("DeviceID") == device_id
553                ).head(testing_sensors_per_device)
554                limited_combinations.append(device_sensors)
555            
556            if limited_combinations:
557                device_sensor_combinations = polars.concat(limited_combinations)
558        
559        total_combinations = len(device_sensor_combinations)
560        self.logger.info(f"Retrieving historical data for {total_combinations} device/sensor combinations")
561        
562        # Use progress bar for bulk operations
563        pbar = tqdm.tqdm(total=total_combinations, desc="Gathering LI-COR readings")
564        
565        for row in device_sensor_combinations.iter_rows(named=True):
566            consolidated_device_id = row["DeviceID"]
567            device_serial = consolidated_device_id.split(":")[-1]  # Extract serial from licor:serial format
568            consolidated_sensor_id = row["SensorID"]
569            # Extract sensor serial from new format: licor:device-sensor -> sensor
570            sensor_part = consolidated_sensor_id.split(":")[-1]  # Get device-sensor part
571            sensor_serial = sensor_part.split("-", 1)[-1]  # Extract sensor part after first dash
572            device_name = row["DeviceName"]
573            sensor_type = row["SensorType"]
574            
575            try:
576                # Get raw data from API
577                raw_data = self.get_sensor_data(
578                    device_serial=device_serial,
579                    sensor_serial=sensor_serial,
580                    start_time_ms=start_utc_ms,
581                    end_time_ms=end_utc_ms
582                )
583                
584                # Transform to standardized schema
585                if raw_data and "sensors" in raw_data and raw_data["sensors"]:
586                    transformed_data = self.transform_to_standardized_schema(
587                        raw_data, 
588                        device_serial=device_serial,
589                        device_metadata=devices_df.filter(
590                            polars.col("DeviceID") == f"licor:{device_serial}"
591                        ).select(["DeviceID", "DeviceName"]).with_columns([
592                            polars.col("DeviceID").str.replace("licor:", "").alias("deviceSerialNumber")
593                        ]).select(["deviceSerialNumber", "DeviceName"]).rename({
594                            "DeviceName": "deviceName"
595                        })
596                    )
597                    
598                    if not transformed_data.is_empty():
599                        readings_list.append(transformed_data)
600                        self.logger.info(f"Retrieved {len(transformed_data)} readings for {device_name}/{sensor_type}")
601                
602            except Exception as e:
603                self.logger.warning(f"Failed to get data for {device_serial}/{sensor_serial}: {str(e)}")
604            
605            pbar.update(1)
606        
607        pbar.close()
608        
609        self.logger.info(f"Successfully retrieved historical data from {len(readings_list)} device/sensor combinations")
610        return readings_list
611    
612    def get_current_readings(self, out_of_scope: List[str] = None,
613                           testing: bool = False,
614                           testing_device_limit: int = 3) -> polars.DataFrame:
615        """
616        Get current sensor readings from the LI-COR API.
617        
618        Parameters
619        ----------
620        out_of_scope : List[str], optional
621            List of device name prefixes to exclude
622        testing : bool, default=False
623            If True, limit to testing devices only
624        testing_device_limit : int, default=3
625            Number of devices to include when testing
626            
627        Returns
628        -------
629        polars.DataFrame
630            Current sensor readings with standardized schema
631        """
632        devices_df = self.get_devices_as_dataframe(
633            out_of_scope=out_of_scope,
634            testing=testing,
635            testing_device_limit=testing_device_limit
636        )
637        
638        if devices_df.is_empty():
639            self.logger.warning("No devices found for current readings")
640            return polars.DataFrame()
641        
642        # Filter to only sensors that have latest readings
643        current_readings = devices_df.filter(
644            polars.col("LatestReading").is_not_null()
645        )
646        
647        if current_readings.is_empty():
648            self.logger.warning("No current readings available")
649            return polars.DataFrame()
650        
651        # Transform latest readings to match historical data format
652        current_utc = int(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp())
653        
654        # Create standardized current readings
655        result = current_readings.with_columns([
656            # Use current timestamp for reading time
657            polars.lit(current_utc).alias("SensorReadingUTC"),
658            polars.col("LatestReading").cast(polars.Float64).alias("SensorReading"),
659        ])
660        
661        # Map specific measurement types to appropriate columns  
662        # Include both Fahrenheit and Celsius temperatures (convert Celsius to Fahrenheit)
663        result = result.with_columns([
664            polars.when(polars.col("SensorType").str.to_lowercase().str.contains("temperature"))
665            .then(
666                polars.when(polars.col("SensorUnits").str.contains("°F|F"))
667                .then(polars.col("LatestReading").cast(polars.Float32))  # Already Fahrenheit
668                .when(polars.col("SensorUnits").str.contains("°C|C"))
669                .then((polars.col("LatestReading") * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0).cast(polars.Float32))  # Convert C to F
670                .otherwise(None)  # Skip unknown temperature units
671            )
672            .otherwise(None)
673            .alias("SensorReadingF"),
674            
675            polars.when(polars.col("SensorType").str.to_lowercase().str.contains("rh|humidity"))
676            .then(polars.col("LatestReading").cast(polars.Float32))
677            .otherwise(None)
678            .alias("SensorReadingRh"),
679        ])
680        
681        # Log converted Celsius temperature sensors
682        celsius_sensors = result.filter(
683            (polars.col("SensorType").str.to_lowercase().str.contains("temperature")) &
684            (polars.col("SensorUnits").str.contains("°C|C")) &
685            (polars.col("SensorReadingF").is_not_null())
686        )
687        
688        if len(celsius_sensors) > 0:
689            for row in celsius_sensors.select(["SensorID", "SensorType", "SensorUnits"]).iter_rows():
690                sensor_id, sensor_type, units = row
691                self.logger.info(f"Converting Celsius to Fahrenheit for current reading: {sensor_id} "
692                               f"(measurement_type: {sensor_type}, units: {units})")
693        
694        # Select only the columns that match the standardized schema
695        # Note: Only SensorReadingF (no SensorReadingC)
696        standardized_columns = [
697            "Source", "SensorID", "DeviceID", "customer_id", "QueryUTC", "SensorReadingUTC", 
698            "SensorName", "DeviceName", "SensorType", "SensorReading", "SensorReadingF", "SensorReadingRh", "Historical"
699        ]
700        
701        # Add missing columns with None values and Historical=False
702        result = result.with_columns(polars.lit(False).alias("Historical"))
703        
704        for col in standardized_columns:
705            if col not in result.columns:
706                if col in ["customer_id", "QueryUTC", "SensorReadingUTC"]:
707                    result = result.with_columns(polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.Int32).alias(col))
708                elif col in ["SensorReadingF", "SensorReadingRh", "SensorReading"]:
709                    result = result.with_columns(polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.Float32).alias(col))
710                else:
711                    result = result.with_columns(polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.String).alias(col))
712        
713        result = result.select([col for col in standardized_columns if col in result.columns])
714        
715        self.logger.info(f"Retrieved {len(result)} current readings from LI-COR")
716        return result
717
718    def sample_raw_data(self, save_to_samples: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
719        """
720        Generate sample raw API data for testing and exploration.
721        
722        This method fetches raw data from the LI-COR API and optionally saves it
723        to the samples directory with timestamps. Fetches sensor data from multiple
724        sensors across different devices for comprehensive testing.
725        
726        Parameters
727        ----------
728        save_to_samples : bool, default=True
729            Whether to save the raw responses to samples/licor/ directory
730            
731        Returns
732        -------
733        Dict[str, Any]
734            Dictionary containing the raw API responses:
735            {
736                'devices': raw_devices_response,
737                'sensor_data_samples': [list of raw sensor data responses]
738            }
739        """
740        results = {}
741        
742        try:
743            print("🔍 Fetching raw device data...")
744            # Get raw devices data
745            raw_devices = self.get_devices()
746            results['devices'] = raw_devices
747            
748            if save_to_samples:
749                timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
750                filename = f"raw_devices_response_{timestamp}.json"
751                filepath = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "samples" / "licor" / filename
752                filepath.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
753                with open(filepath, 'w') as f:
754                    json.dump(raw_devices, f, indent=2, default=str)
755                print(f"Saved JSON data to: {filepath}")
756            
757            devices_data = raw_devices.get('devices', []) if isinstance(raw_devices, dict) else raw_devices
758            print(f"✅ Retrieved {len(devices_data) if isinstance(devices_data, list) else 'N/A'} devices")
759            
760            # Try to get sample sensor data from multiple devices/sensors
761            sensor_data_samples = []
762            max_devices = 3  # Sample up to 3 devices
763            max_sensors_per_device = 2  # Sample up to 2 sensors per device
764            devices_sampled = 0
765            
766            if isinstance(devices_data, list) and len(devices_data) > 0:
767                print(f"🔍 Fetching sensor data from up to {max_devices} devices with {max_sensors_per_device} sensors each...")
768                
769                # Get last 6 hours for quick sample
770                end_time = datetime.datetime.now()
771                start_time = end_time - datetime.timedelta(hours=6)
772                start_ms = int(start_time.timestamp() * 1000)
773                end_ms = int(end_time.timestamp() * 1000)
774                
775                for device in devices_data:
776                    if devices_sampled >= max_devices:
777                        break
778                        
779                    if device.get('sensors') and len(device['sensors']) > 0:
780                        device_serial = device.get('serialNumber') or device.get('deviceSerialNumber')
781                        device_name = device.get('deviceName', 'Unknown Device')
782                        
783                        if not device_serial:
784                            continue
785                            
786                        sensors_sampled = 0
787                        print(f"\n📱 Device: {device_name} ({device_serial})")
788                        
789                        for sensor in device['sensors']:
790                            if sensors_sampled >= max_sensors_per_device:
791                                break
792                                
793                            sensor_serial = sensor.get('serialNumber') or sensor.get('sensorSerialNumber')
794                            sensor_type = sensor.get('measurementType', 'Unknown')
795                            
796                            if not sensor_serial:
797                                continue
798                                
799                            print(f"  🔍 Fetching data for sensor {sensor_serial} ({sensor_type})...")
800                            
801                            try:
802                                raw_sensor_data = self.get_sensor_data(
803                                    device_serial=device_serial,
804                                    sensor_serial=sensor_serial,
805                                    start_time_ms=start_ms,
806                                    end_time_ms=end_ms
807                                )
808                                
809                                sensor_data_samples.append({
810                                    'device_serial': device_serial,
811                                    'device_name': device_name,
812                                    'sensor_serial': sensor_serial,
813                                    'sensor_type': sensor_type,
814                                    'raw_data': raw_sensor_data
815                                })
816                                
817                                if save_to_samples:
818                                    timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
819                                    filename = f"raw_sensor_data_{device_serial}_{sensor_serial}_{timestamp}.json"
820                                    filepath = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "samples" / "licor" / filename
821                                    filepath.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
822                                    with open(filepath, 'w') as f:
823                                        json.dump(raw_sensor_data, f, indent=2, default=str)
824                                    print(f"    💾 Saved to: {filepath}")
825                                
826                                print(f"    ✅ Retrieved sensor data for {device_serial}/{sensor_serial}")
827                                sensors_sampled += 1
828                                
829                            except Exception as e:
830                                print(f"    ⚠️ Could not get sensor data for {device_serial}/{sensor_serial}: {e}")
831                                continue
832                        
833                        if sensors_sampled > 0:
834                            devices_sampled += 1
835            
836            results['sensor_data_samples'] = sensor_data_samples
837            
838            # Print summary
839            print(f"\n📋 Sample Data Summary:")
840            print(f"   • Devices: {len(devices_data)} found")
841            print(f"   • Sensor data samples: {len(sensor_data_samples)} collected from {devices_sampled} devices")
842            
843            if sensor_data_samples:
844                for i, sample in enumerate(sensor_data_samples, 1):
845                    print(f"     {i}. {sample['device_name']} - {sample['sensor_type']} ({sample['sensor_serial']})")
846            
847            if save_to_samples:
848                print(f"   • Files saved to: samples/licor/")
849            
850            return results
851            
852        except Exception as e:
853            print(f"❌ Error generating sample data: {e}")
854            raise
LicorClient(logger: Optional[logging.Logger] = None, home_directory: str = '.') 
 95    def __init__(self, logger: Optional[logging.Logger] = None, home_directory: str = "."):
 96        """
 97        Initialize the LI-COR API client.
 98        
 99        Parameters
100        ----------
101        logger : Optional[logging.Logger]
102            Logger instance for recording API interactions
103        home_directory : str, default="."
104            Base directory for finding .env file
105        """
106        # Read API key from environment
107        api_key = None
108        env_file_path = os.path.join(home_directory, ".env")
109        try:
110            with open(env_file_path) as f:
111                for line in f:
112                    if line.startswith("LICOR_API_KEY"):
113                        api_key = line.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
114                        break
115        except FileNotFoundError:
116            pass
117        
118        if not api_key:
119            raise ValueError(
120                f"LICOR_API_KEY not found in .env file at {env_file_path}. "
121                f"If running from a subdirectory, set home_directory parameter to parent directory (e.g., home_directory='..').")
122        
123        self.api_key = api_key
124        self.logger = logger or logging.getLogger(__name__)
125        self.base_url = "https://api.licor.cloud/v2"
126        self.headers = {
127            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
128            "Content-Type": "application/json"
129        }
130        
131        # Configure logging for detailed API response inspection
132        if self.logger.level == logging.NOTSET:
133            self.logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

def get_sensor_data( self, device_serial: str, sensor_serial: str, start_time_ms: int, end_time_ms: int) -> Dict[str, Any]: 
200    def get_sensor_data(self, device_serial: str, sensor_serial: str, 
201                       start_time_ms: int, end_time_ms: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
202        """
203        Get sensor data for a specific device and sensor.
204        
205        Note: LI-COR API limits historical data queries to maximum 1 year (365 days).
206        If the requested date range exceeds this limit, it will be automatically capped.
207        
208        Parameters
209        ----------
210        device_serial : str
211            Device serial number
212        sensor_serial : str
213            Sensor serial number
214        start_time_ms : int
215            Start time as UTC timestamp in milliseconds
216        end_time_ms : int
217            End time as UTC timestamp in milliseconds
218            
219        Returns
220        -------
221        Dict[str, Any]
222            Raw sensor data from API for inspection
223        """
224        # Validate and cap date range - LI-COR API limits to less than 1 year maximum
225        max_days = 364  # Use 364 days to be safe with API limitations
226        max_milliseconds = max_days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
227        date_range_ms = end_time_ms - start_time_ms
228        
229        if date_range_ms > max_milliseconds:
230            start_time_ms = end_time_ms - max_milliseconds
231            self.logger.warning(
232                f"Date range ({date_range_ms // (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)} days) exceeds LI-COR API limit of {max_days} days. "
233                f"Capping to most recent {max_days} days for {device_serial}/{sensor_serial}."
234            )
235        
236        self.logger.info(f"get_sensor_data for device {device_serial}, sensor {sensor_serial}")
237        
238        params = {
239            "deviceSerialNumber": device_serial,
240            "sensorSerialNumber": sensor_serial,
241            "startTime": start_time_ms,
242            "endTime": end_time_ms
243        }
244        
245        response_data = self._make_api_request("data", params)
246        
247        # Check for pagination - this is an unhandled case that could mean missing data
248        if isinstance(response_data, dict) and response_data.get("moreResults") is True:
249            error_msg = (
250                f"CRITICAL: API returned moreResults=true for {device_serial}/{sensor_serial}. "
251                f"This indicates pagination/truncated results that are not currently handled. "
252                f"Data may be incomplete!"
253            )
254            self.logger.error(error_msg)
255            raise Exception(error_msg)
256        
257        # Log basic data retrieval info
258        if isinstance(response_data, dict):
259            if "message" in response_data:
260                self.logger.info(f"API message: {response_data['message']}")
261            
262            # Log data count for tracking
263            for key in ["data", "readings", "measurements", "values", "results", "sensors"]:
264                if key in response_data and isinstance(response_data[key], list):
265                    self.logger.info(f"Retrieved {len(response_data[key])} items from '{key}'")
266                    break
267        
268        return response_data

def transform_to_standardized_schema( self, raw_data: Dict[str, Any], device_serial: str = None, device_metadata: polars.dataframe.frame.DataFrame = None) -> polars.dataframe.frame.DataFrame: 
270    def transform_to_standardized_schema(self, raw_data: Dict[str, Any], 
271                                       device_serial: str = None,
272                                       device_metadata: polars.DataFrame = None) -> polars.DataFrame:
273        """
274        Transform LI-COR API response data to standardized EnvironmentData schema.
275        
276        Note: This method assumes moreResults=false (complete data). If moreResults=true
277        is ever encountered, get_sensor_data() will raise an exception since pagination
278        is not currently handled.
279        
280        Parameters
281        ----------
282        raw_data : Dict[str, Any]
283            Raw API response from get_sensor_data
284        device_serial : str, optional
285            Device serial number to populate DeviceID field
286        device_metadata : polars.DataFrame, optional
287            Device metadata to attach to readings
288            
289        Returns
290        -------
291        polars.DataFrame
292            Transformed data matching the standardized schema
293        """
294        if not isinstance(raw_data, dict) or "sensors" not in raw_data:
295            self.logger.warning("No sensor data found in response")
296            return polars.DataFrame()
297        
298        # Extract device name from metadata upfront for use in record creation
299        device_name = None
300        if device_metadata is not None and not device_metadata.is_empty():
301            if "deviceName" in device_metadata.columns and len(device_metadata) > 0:
302                device_name = device_metadata.select("deviceName").item(0, 0)
303        
304        all_readings = []
305        
306        for sensor_info in raw_data["sensors"]:
307            sensor_serial = sensor_info.get("sensorSerialNumber", "unknown")
308            
309            for measurement_data in sensor_info.get("data", []):
310                measurement_type = measurement_data.get("measurementType", "unknown")
311                units = measurement_data.get("units", "")
312                records = measurement_data.get("records", [])
313                
314                # Convert records to DataFrame
315                if records:
316                    # Create DataFrame from records (timestamp_ms, value pairs)
317                    df = polars.DataFrame({
318                        "timestamp_ms": [record[0] for record in records],
319                        "value": [record[1] for record in records]
320                    })
321                    
322                    # Add metadata
323                    df = df.with_columns([
324                        # Convert timestamp from ms to seconds
325                        (polars.col("timestamp_ms") / 1000).cast(polars.Int64).alias("SensorReadingUTC"),
326                        polars.lit(f"licor:{device_serial or 'unknown'}-{sensor_serial}").alias("SensorID"),
327                        polars.lit(measurement_type).alias("SensorType"),
328                        polars.lit(units).alias("SensorUnits"),
329                        polars.lit("LI-COR").alias("Source"),
330                        
331                        # Add schema columns - populate DeviceID with device serial when available
332                        polars.lit(f"licor:{device_serial}" if device_serial else None).alias("DeviceID"),
333                        polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.Int32).alias("customer_id"),
334                        # Set SensorName from device metadata: DeviceName_SensorType (e.g., "RX Station 1_RH")
335                        polars.lit(f"{device_name}_{measurement_type}" if device_name else None, dtype=polars.String).alias("SensorName"),
336                        polars.lit(device_name, dtype=polars.String).alias("DeviceName"),
337                        polars.lit(int(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp())).alias("QueryUTC"),
338                        polars.lit(True).alias("Historical"),
339                    ])
340                    
341                    # Map measurement types to standardized reading columns
342                    # Focus on temperature and humidity only
343                    if measurement_type.lower() in ["temperature", "temp"]:
344                        if "°F" in units or "F" in units:
345                            # Already in Fahrenheit - keep this sensor
346                            df = df.with_columns(polars.col("value").cast(polars.Float32).alias("SensorReadingF"))
347                        elif "°C" in units or "C" in units:
348                            # Celsius detected - convert to Fahrenheit
349                            self.logger.info(f"Converting Celsius to Fahrenheit for sensor: {sensor_serial} "
350                                           f"(measurement_type: {measurement_type}, units: {units})")
351                            df = df.with_columns(
352                                (polars.col("value") * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0).cast(polars.Float32).alias("SensorReadingF")
353                            )
354                        else:
355                            # Unknown temperature units - skip and log
356                            self.logger.warning(f"Unknown temperature units for sensor {sensor_serial}: "
357                                              f"measurement_type={measurement_type}, units='{units}' - skipping")
358                            continue
359                    elif measurement_type.lower() in ["rh", "humidity", "relative humidity"]:
360                        df = df.with_columns(polars.col("value").cast(polars.Float32).alias("SensorReadingRh"))
361                    # elif measurement_type.lower() in ["dew point", "dewpoint"]:
362                    #     if "°F" in units or "F" in units:
363                    #         df = df.with_columns(polars.col("value").cast(polars.Float32).alias("SensorReadingDewPointF"))
364                    #     else:
365                    #         df = df.with_columns(polars.col("value").cast(polars.Float64).alias("SensorReadingDewPointC"))
366                    else:
367                        # Skip other sensor types - only collect temperature and humidity
368                        continue
369                    
370                    # Drop the temporary columns
371                    df = df.drop(["timestamp_ms", "value"])
372                    
373                    all_readings.append(df)
374        
375        if not all_readings:
376            return polars.DataFrame()
377        
378        # Concatenate all readings
379        result = polars.concat(all_readings, how="diagonal")
380        
381        # Note: LI-COR API natively returns data in 15-minute intervals,
382        # consistent with Coris (MinReadingSpacing=900) and Conserv (15-min exports)
383        
384        self.logger.info(f"Transformed {len(result)} readings from LI-COR data")
385        return result

Transform LI-COR API response data to standardized EnvironmentData schema.

Note: This method assumes moreResults=false (complete data). If moreResults=true is ever encountered, get_sensor_data() will raise an exception since pagination is not currently handled.

Parameters

raw_data : Dict[str, Any] Raw API response from get_sensor_data device_serial : str, optional Device serial number to populate DeviceID field device_metadata : polars.DataFrame, optional Device metadata to attach to readings

Returns

polars.DataFrame Transformed data matching the standardized schema

def get_devices_as_dataframe( self, out_of_scope: List[str] = None, testing: bool = False, testing_device_limit: int = 3) -> polars.dataframe.frame.DataFrame: 
387    def get_devices_as_dataframe(self, out_of_scope: List[str] = None,
388                               testing: bool = False,
389                               testing_device_limit: int = 3) -> polars.DataFrame:
390        """
391        Get devices and sensors as a standardized DataFrame.
392        
393        Parameters
394        ----------
395        out_of_scope : List[str], optional
396            List of device name prefixes to exclude
397        testing : bool, default=False
398            If True, limit to first few devices for testing
399        testing_device_limit : int, default=3
400            Number of devices to include when testing mode is enabled
401            
402        Returns
403        -------
404        polars.DataFrame
405            Device and sensor data with standardized schema
406        """
407        out_of_scope = out_of_scope or []
408        current_utc = int(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp())
409        
410        self.logger.info("get_devices_as_dataframe")
411        devices_response = self.get_devices()
412        
413        if not isinstance(devices_response, dict) or "devices" not in devices_response:
414            self.logger.error("Invalid device response format")
415            return polars.DataFrame()
416        
417        devices = devices_response["devices"]
418        
419        # Filter out-of-scope devices
420        if out_of_scope:
421            devices = [d for d in devices 
422                      if not any(d.get("deviceName", "").startswith(prefix) for prefix in out_of_scope)]
423        
424        # Apply testing limits
425        if testing and testing_device_limit:
426            devices = devices[:testing_device_limit]
427        
428        device_records = []
429        
430        for device in devices:
431            device_serial = device.get("deviceSerialNumber")
432            device_name = device.get("deviceName", "Unknown Device")
433            
434            if "sensors" in device:
435                # Create a record for each sensor (temperature and humidity only)
436                for sensor in device["sensors"]:
437                    sensor_serial = sensor.get("sensorSerialNumber")
438                    measurement_type = sensor.get("measurementType", "Unknown")
439                    units = sensor.get("units", "")
440                    latest_value = sensor.get("latest")
441                    
442                    # Filter to only temperature and humidity sensors
443                    if measurement_type.lower() not in ["temperature", "temp", "rh", "humidity", "relative humidity"]:
444                        continue
445                    
446                    device_records.append({
447                        "DeviceID": f"licor:{device_serial}",
448                        "DeviceName": device_name,
449                        "SensorID": f"licor:{device_serial}-{sensor_serial}",
450                        "SensorName": f"{device_name}_{measurement_type}",
451                        "SensorType": measurement_type,
452                        "SensorUnits": units,
453                        "LatestReading": latest_value,
454                        "ProductCode": device.get("productCode"),
455                        "LastConnectionTime": device.get("lastConnectionTime"),
456                        "LoggingState": device.get("loggingState"),
457                        "Alarmed": device.get("alarmed", False),
458                        "UnitSystem": device.get("unitSystem"),
459                    })
460        
461        if not device_records:
462            return polars.DataFrame()
463        
464        # Create DataFrame
465        result = polars.DataFrame(device_records)
466        
467        # Add standardized schema columns
468        result = result.with_columns([
469            polars.lit(current_utc).alias("QueryUTC"),
470            polars.lit("LI-COR").alias("Source"),
471            polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.Int32).alias("customer_id"),
472        ])
473        
474        self.logger.info(f"Retrieved {len(result)} device/sensor combinations")
475        return result

Get devices and sensors as a standardized DataFrame.

Parameters

out_of_scope : List[str], optional List of device name prefixes to exclude testing : bool, default=False If True, limit to first few devices for testing testing_device_limit : int, default=3 Number of devices to include when testing mode is enabled

Returns

polars.DataFrame Device and sensor data with standardized schema

def get_historical_data( self, start_utc: int, end_utc: int, out_of_scope: List[str] = None, testing: bool = False, testing_device_limit: int = 2, testing_sensors_per_device: int = 2) -> List[polars.dataframe.frame.DataFrame]: 
477    def get_historical_data(self, start_utc: int, end_utc: int,
478                               out_of_scope: List[str] = None,
479                               testing: bool = False,
480                               testing_device_limit: int = 2,
481                               testing_sensors_per_device: int = 2) -> List[polars.DataFrame]:
482        """
483        Get historical data for all devices and sensors in bulk.
484        
485        Note: LI-COR API limits historical data queries to maximum 1 year (365 days).
486        If the requested date range exceeds this limit, it will be automatically capped.
487        
488        Parameters
489        ----------
490        start_utc : int
491            Start time as UTC timestamp in seconds
492        end_utc : int
493            End time as UTC timestamp in seconds
494        out_of_scope : List[str], optional
495            List of device name prefixes to exclude
496        testing : bool, default=False
497            If True, limit to first few devices and sensors
498        testing_device_limit : int, default=2
499            Number of devices to include when testing
500        testing_sensors_per_device : int, default=2
501            Number of sensors per device when testing
502            
503        Returns
504        -------
505        List[polars.DataFrame]
506            List of DataFrames containing historical readings
507        """
508        # Validate and cap date range - LI-COR API limits to less than 1 year maximum
509        max_days = 364  # Use 364 days to be safe with API limitations
510        max_seconds = max_days * 24 * 60 * 60
511        date_range_seconds = end_utc - start_utc
512        
513        if date_range_seconds > max_seconds:
514            original_start = start_utc
515            start_utc = end_utc - max_seconds
516            self.logger.warning(
517                f"Date range ({date_range_seconds // 86400} days) exceeds LI-COR API limit of {max_days} days. "
518                f"Capping to most recent {max_days} days."
519            )
520            self.logger.info(f"Adjusted start_utc from {original_start} to {start_utc}")
521        
522        self.logger.info(f"Using date range: {(end_utc - start_utc) // 86400} days of historical data")
523        devices_df = self.get_devices_as_dataframe(
524            out_of_scope=out_of_scope,
525            testing=testing,
526            testing_device_limit=testing_device_limit
527        )
528        
529        if devices_df.is_empty():
530            self.logger.warning("No devices found for bulk historical data retrieval")
531            return []
532        
533        # Convert timestamps to milliseconds for API
534        start_utc_ms = start_utc * 1000
535        end_utc_ms = end_utc * 1000
536        
537        readings_list = []
538        
539        # Get unique device/sensor combinations
540        device_sensor_combinations = (
541            devices_df
542            .filter(polars.col("SensorID").is_not_null())
543            .select(["DeviceID", "SensorID", "DeviceName", "SensorType"])
544            .unique()
545        )
546        
547        if testing:
548            # Group by device and limit sensors per device
549            limited_combinations = []
550            for device_id in device_sensor_combinations["DeviceID"].unique():
551                device_sensors = device_sensor_combinations.filter(
552                    polars.col("DeviceID") == device_id
553                ).head(testing_sensors_per_device)
554                limited_combinations.append(device_sensors)
555            
556            if limited_combinations:
557                device_sensor_combinations = polars.concat(limited_combinations)
558        
559        total_combinations = len(device_sensor_combinations)
560        self.logger.info(f"Retrieving historical data for {total_combinations} device/sensor combinations")
561        
562        # Use progress bar for bulk operations
563        pbar = tqdm.tqdm(total=total_combinations, desc="Gathering LI-COR readings")
564        
565        for row in device_sensor_combinations.iter_rows(named=True):
566            consolidated_device_id = row["DeviceID"]
567            device_serial = consolidated_device_id.split(":")[-1]  # Extract serial from licor:serial format
568            consolidated_sensor_id = row["SensorID"]
569            # Extract sensor serial from new format: licor:device-sensor -> sensor
570            sensor_part = consolidated_sensor_id.split(":")[-1]  # Get device-sensor part
571            sensor_serial = sensor_part.split("-", 1)[-1]  # Extract sensor part after first dash
572            device_name = row["DeviceName"]
573            sensor_type = row["SensorType"]
574            
575            try:
576                # Get raw data from API
577                raw_data = self.get_sensor_data(
578                    device_serial=device_serial,
579                    sensor_serial=sensor_serial,
580                    start_time_ms=start_utc_ms,
581                    end_time_ms=end_utc_ms
582                )
583                
584                # Transform to standardized schema
585                if raw_data and "sensors" in raw_data and raw_data["sensors"]:
586                    transformed_data = self.transform_to_standardized_schema(
587                        raw_data, 
588                        device_serial=device_serial,
589                        device_metadata=devices_df.filter(
590                            polars.col("DeviceID") == f"licor:{device_serial}"
591                        ).select(["DeviceID", "DeviceName"]).with_columns([
592                            polars.col("DeviceID").str.replace("licor:", "").alias("deviceSerialNumber")
593                        ]).select(["deviceSerialNumber", "DeviceName"]).rename({
594                            "DeviceName": "deviceName"
595                        })
596                    )
597                    
598                    if not transformed_data.is_empty():
599                        readings_list.append(transformed_data)
600                        self.logger.info(f"Retrieved {len(transformed_data)} readings for {device_name}/{sensor_type}")
601                
602            except Exception as e:
603                self.logger.warning(f"Failed to get data for {device_serial}/{sensor_serial}: {str(e)}")
604            
605            pbar.update(1)
606        
607        pbar.close()
608        
609        self.logger.info(f"Successfully retrieved historical data from {len(readings_list)} device/sensor combinations")
610        return readings_list

def get_current_readings( self, out_of_scope: List[str] = None, testing: bool = False, testing_device_limit: int = 3) -> polars.dataframe.frame.DataFrame: 
612    def get_current_readings(self, out_of_scope: List[str] = None,
613                           testing: bool = False,
614                           testing_device_limit: int = 3) -> polars.DataFrame:
615        """
616        Get current sensor readings from the LI-COR API.
617        
618        Parameters
619        ----------
620        out_of_scope : List[str], optional
621            List of device name prefixes to exclude
622        testing : bool, default=False
623            If True, limit to testing devices only
624        testing_device_limit : int, default=3
625            Number of devices to include when testing
626            
627        Returns
628        -------
629        polars.DataFrame
630            Current sensor readings with standardized schema
631        """
632        devices_df = self.get_devices_as_dataframe(
633            out_of_scope=out_of_scope,
634            testing=testing,
635            testing_device_limit=testing_device_limit
636        )
637        
638        if devices_df.is_empty():
639            self.logger.warning("No devices found for current readings")
640            return polars.DataFrame()
641        
642        # Filter to only sensors that have latest readings
643        current_readings = devices_df.filter(
644            polars.col("LatestReading").is_not_null()
645        )
646        
647        if current_readings.is_empty():
648            self.logger.warning("No current readings available")
649            return polars.DataFrame()
650        
651        # Transform latest readings to match historical data format
652        current_utc = int(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp())
653        
654        # Create standardized current readings
655        result = current_readings.with_columns([
656            # Use current timestamp for reading time
657            polars.lit(current_utc).alias("SensorReadingUTC"),
658            polars.col("LatestReading").cast(polars.Float64).alias("SensorReading"),
659        ])
660        
661        # Map specific measurement types to appropriate columns  
662        # Include both Fahrenheit and Celsius temperatures (convert Celsius to Fahrenheit)
663        result = result.with_columns([
664            polars.when(polars.col("SensorType").str.to_lowercase().str.contains("temperature"))
665            .then(
666                polars.when(polars.col("SensorUnits").str.contains("°F|F"))
667                .then(polars.col("LatestReading").cast(polars.Float32))  # Already Fahrenheit
668                .when(polars.col("SensorUnits").str.contains("°C|C"))
669                .then((polars.col("LatestReading") * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0).cast(polars.Float32))  # Convert C to F
670                .otherwise(None)  # Skip unknown temperature units
671            )
672            .otherwise(None)
673            .alias("SensorReadingF"),
674            
675            polars.when(polars.col("SensorType").str.to_lowercase().str.contains("rh|humidity"))
676            .then(polars.col("LatestReading").cast(polars.Float32))
677            .otherwise(None)
678            .alias("SensorReadingRh"),
679        ])
680        
681        # Log converted Celsius temperature sensors
682        celsius_sensors = result.filter(
683            (polars.col("SensorType").str.to_lowercase().str.contains("temperature")) &
684            (polars.col("SensorUnits").str.contains("°C|C")) &
685            (polars.col("SensorReadingF").is_not_null())
686        )
687        
688        if len(celsius_sensors) > 0:
689            for row in celsius_sensors.select(["SensorID", "SensorType", "SensorUnits"]).iter_rows():
690                sensor_id, sensor_type, units = row
691                self.logger.info(f"Converting Celsius to Fahrenheit for current reading: {sensor_id} "
692                               f"(measurement_type: {sensor_type}, units: {units})")
693        
694        # Select only the columns that match the standardized schema
695        # Note: Only SensorReadingF (no SensorReadingC)
696        standardized_columns = [
697            "Source", "SensorID", "DeviceID", "customer_id", "QueryUTC", "SensorReadingUTC", 
698            "SensorName", "DeviceName", "SensorType", "SensorReading", "SensorReadingF", "SensorReadingRh", "Historical"
699        ]
700        
701        # Add missing columns with None values and Historical=False
702        result = result.with_columns(polars.lit(False).alias("Historical"))
703        
704        for col in standardized_columns:
705            if col not in result.columns:
706                if col in ["customer_id", "QueryUTC", "SensorReadingUTC"]:
707                    result = result.with_columns(polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.Int32).alias(col))
708                elif col in ["SensorReadingF", "SensorReadingRh", "SensorReading"]:
709                    result = result.with_columns(polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.Float32).alias(col))
710                else:
711                    result = result.with_columns(polars.lit(None, dtype=polars.String).alias(col))
712        
713        result = result.select([col for col in standardized_columns if col in result.columns])
714        
715        self.logger.info(f"Retrieved {len(result)} current readings from LI-COR")
716        return result

724        sensors across different devices for comprehensive testing.

731        Returns

749                timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
750                filename = f"raw_devices_response_{timestamp}.json"
751                filepath = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "samples" / "licor" / filename
752                filepath.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

755                print(f"Saved JSON data to: {filepath}")
756            
757            devices_data = raw_devices.get('devices', []) if isinstance(raw_devices, dict) else raw_devices
758            print(f"✅ Retrieved {len(devices_data) if isinstance(devices_data, list) else 'N/A'} devices")
759            
760            # Try to get sample sensor data from multiple devices/sensors
761            sensor_data_samples = []
762            max_devices = 3  # Sample up to 3 devices
763            max_sensors_per_device = 2  # Sample up to 2 sensors per device
764            devices_sampled = 0
765            
766            if isinstance(devices_data, list) and len(devices_data) > 0:

768                
769                # Get last 6 hours for quick sample

771                start_time = end_time - datetime.timedelta(hours=6)
772                start_ms = int(start_time.timestamp() * 1000)
773                end_ms = int(end_time.timestamp() * 1000)
774                
775                for device in devices_data:
776                    if devices_sampled >= max_devices:
777                        break
778                        
779                    if device.get('sensors') and len(device['sensors']) > 0:
780                        device_serial = device.get('serialNumber') or device.get('deviceSerialNumber')
781                        device_name = device.get('deviceName', 'Unknown Device')
782                        
783                        if not device_serial:
784                            continue
785                            
786                        sensors_sampled = 0
787                        print(f"\n📱 Device: {device_name} ({device_serial})")
788                        
789                        for sensor in device['sensors']:
790                            if sensors_sampled >= max_sensors_per_device:
791                                break
792                                
793                            sensor_serial = sensor.get('serialNumber') or sensor.get('sensorSerialNumber')
794                            sensor_type = sensor.get('measurementType', 'Unknown')
795                            
796                            if not sensor_serial:
797                                continue
798                                
799                            print(f"  🔍 Fetching data for sensor {sensor_serial} ({sensor_type})...")
800                            
801                            try:
802                                raw_sensor_data = self.get_sensor_data(
803                                    device_serial=device_serial,
804                                    sensor_serial=sensor_serial,
805                                    start_time_ms=start_ms,
806                                    end_time_ms=end_ms
807                                )
808                                
809                                sensor_data_samples.append({
810                                    'device_serial': device_serial,
811                                    'device_name': device_name,
812                                    'sensor_serial': sensor_serial,
813                                    'sensor_type': sensor_type,
814                                    'raw_data': raw_sensor_data
815                                })
816                                
817                                if save_to_samples:
818                                    timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
819                                    filename = f"raw_sensor_data_{device_serial}_{sensor_serial}_{timestamp}.json"
820                                    filepath = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "samples" / "licor" / filename
821                                    filepath.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
822                                    with open(filepath, 'w') as f:
823                                        json.dump(raw_sensor_data, f, indent=2, default=str)
824                                    print(f"    💾 Saved to: {filepath}")
825                                
826                                print(f"    ✅ Retrieved sensor data for {device_serial}/{sensor_serial}")
827                                sensors_sampled += 1
828                                
829                            except Exception as e:
830                                print(f"    ⚠️ Could not get sensor data for {device_serial}/{sensor_serial}: {e}")
831                                continue
832                        
833                        if sensors_sampled > 0:
834                            devices_sampled += 1
835            
836            results['sensor_data_samples'] = sensor_data_samples
837            
838            # Print summary
839            print(f"\n📋 Sample Data Summary:")
840            print(f"   • Devices: {len(devices_data)} found")
841            print(f"   • Sensor data samples: {len(sensor_data_samples)} collected from {devices_sampled} devices")
842            
843            if sensor_data_samples:
844                for i, sample in enumerate(sensor_data_samples, 1):
845                    print(f"     {i}. {sample['device_name']} - {sample['sensor_type']} ({sample['sensor_serial']})")
846            
847            if save_to_samples:
848                print(f"   • Files saved to: samples/licor/")
849            
850            return results
851            
852        except Exception as e:
853            print(f"❌ Error generating sample data: {e}")
854            raise

Generate sample raw API data for testing and exploration.

This method fetches raw data from the LI-COR API and optionally saves it to the samples directory with timestamps. Fetches sensor data from multiple sensors across different devices for comprehensive testing.

save_to_samples : bool, default=True Whether to save the raw responses to samples/licor/ directory

Returns
